exclusion_detail: Section 2.1 says the key intermediates 4 (the propargyl ether of the 2-arylbenzothiazole), 7 (2-chloro-N-arylacetamide) and 8 were 'prepared according to the previously described method' [35-38]; only the final click step (7 + NaN3, then 4, CuSO4/ascorbate) has a procedure here. In addition the abstract names no single lead (8b, 8f, 8i as highly cytotoxic, 8g similar to doxorubicin in MCF7), so the lead rule gives no_lead_identifiable as well.

lead.label: none single (8b, 8f, 8i named together; 8g for MCF7)
lead.why: Abstract: 'Compounds 8b, 8f and 8i possessed high cytotoxic activity as compared with doxorubicin. Compound 8g has a similar inhibitory effect ... as doxorubicin.'

notes: No SI in the bundle. Every member 8a-8o depends on the same unexplained intermediates 4 and 7, so none qualifies.
